method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: 8 handwritten rows sum to EXACTLY 1,700.00 = the cover line 1 figure, identical in the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns (LAST is a bare dash -- first report of the cycle, so the two scopes coincide; recorded cumulative). Cover line 2 (the <=$50 aggregate) is a bare dash in all three columns, so no small-donor aggregate competes with the anchor. Two of the eight rows are exactly 50.00 and so are not strictly 'more than $50.00', but the filer counted them in line 1 and the arithmetic closes with them -- transcribed as printed, not reallocated. The Carr form prints no schedule total.

expenditures.detail: 10 handwritten rows sum to EXACTLY 2,058.85 = cover line 3, identical in the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns (LAST is a bare dash). Scope cumulative, the two coinciding on a first report. The Carr form prints no schedule total on Form B, so the cover line is the only anchor.

gates.page_subtotal: Neither Carr schedule prints a total or a page subtotal, so both sides were gated against the cover: p2 rows 1,700.00 = cover line 1 -- GATES EXACTLY; p3 rows 2,058.85 = cover line 3 -- GATES EXACTLY.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p2 --dpi 200: status 'gaps', only 12 bands recovered from a ~2.34%-pitch grid (this scan is faint and the tool dropped most rules) -- treated as evidence, not an oracle, and the ink was counted by eye: 8 inked rows on Form A, 8 emitted. p3: status 'gaps', 5 bands; ink counted by eye: 10 inked rows on Form B, 10 emitted. Everything below the last inked row on BOTH pages is faint printed bleed-through from the reverse of the sheet (the statute page), verified at 600 dpi to be machine-set two-column text and NOT filer ink -- no rows emitted from it.
gates.geometry_proof: Form A p2: first-row amount box renders 'Logan, UT 84321  100.00' (row 1's own value); last-row box renders 'Wellsville, ut  350.00' (row 8) and the control one pitch below renders EMPTY. Form B p3: first-row box renders '618.00' (row 1); last-row box renders 'ter ... for Parade  53.14' (row 10) and the control one pitch below renders EMPTY apart from the reverse-side bleed-through. Row index confirmed unshifted on both pages.
gates.balance_chain: Cumulative column: 1,700.00 - 2,058.85 = -358.85, and the cover's line 4 prints '-358.85'. CLOSES EXACTLY, including the sign. The <=$50 line is a dash and contributes nothing. No prior filing by this filer in this chunk; every LAST cell is a bare dash.

escalation_note: 600 dpi tight crops of (1) the whole Form A amount column -- all 8 amounts re-read identically; (2) the whole Form A date column -- confirming rows 2 and 3 carry NO date at all and row 8 carries the range '6/23-24/14'; (3) the whole Form B amount column -- all 10 amounts re-read identically; (4) the cover money block lines 3-4, confirming 2058.85 (the THIS cell has an over-written digit; the CUMULATIVE cell is clean and identical) and the negative balance '-358.85'; (5) a 600 dpi crop of the faint region below the last Form B row, which resolved as printed reverse-side bleed-through rather than handwriting. Both sides then closed to the cent against the cover, so no glyph read was left to arbitrate.
notes: Cover 'Name of Office' reads 'Recorder', Office District 'Cache County' -- the chunk file's office 'Recorder' AGREES. Candidate 'Bradley P. White'; chunk says 'White' -- agrees. Cover date '6/25/14'; the chunk's date column says 2014-07-25 -- the DOCUMENT says the filer signed 25 June 2014 (the clerk stamp on this scan is rotated into the right margin and only partly legible), so the chunk's date is contradicted and that is flagged here. IN-SCOPE (county office). One IN-KIND contribution is recorded on this filing and it is the only in-kind row in the chunk: row 8, 'Randy Wall (In Kind, Radio Ads)' 350.00 -- the label is written by the filer inside the contributor cell, since the Carr form has no in-kind column; in_kind was set on that explicit label alone, never inferred. Three contribution rows carry no usable date (rows 2 and 3 have an EMPTY date cell, row 8 has the range '6/23-24/14'); all three are BLANK + needs_review with the verbatim kept in the note, and no year or day was ever supplied from the report date. Contributor addresses are handwritten in the clear; only city and state were kept, and the candidate's own street address, ZIP, home phone and business phone on the cover were discarded at read time.
